comparisons.peer_topic: Embedded segment net revenue and drivers for fiscal year 2024
comparisons.peer_summary: Embedded net revenue decreased by 33% to $3.6 billion in 2024 from $5.3 billion in 2023, primarily due to lower demand as customers normalized inventory levels.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel Foundry and AMD’s Embedded segment reported significant year-over-year revenue declines in 2024, though driven by different specific market factors. Intel Foundry’s external revenue decreased 60% due to lower traditional packaging services and equipment sales, whereas AMD’s Embedded net revenue decreased 33% primarily because customers normalized inventory levels leading to lower demand.

Embedded net revenue of $3.6 billion in 2024 decreased by 33%, compared to net revenue of $5.3 billion in 2023.
The decrease in net revenue was primarily due to lower demand as customers continued to normalize their inventory levels.

comparisons.peer_summary: Gaming net revenue decreased by 58% to $2.6 billion in 2024 from $6.2 billion in 2023, primarily driven by lower semi-custom product revenue.
comparisons.comparison: Similar to Intel Foundry's sharp revenue contraction, AMD’s Gaming segment experienced a substantial year-over-year revenue drop of 58% in 2024, attributed to lower semi-custom product revenue. This mirrors the significant negative revenue performance observed in Intel's foundry business.
